fact: As of the 26 June 2026 roundtable, Sao Tome and Principe is a Party to the Council of Europe Budapest Convention, its newest party as of late 2025, and UNODC urged it to sign the UN Convention against Cybercrime; the text does not name the domestic law or any case under it.
title: UN convenes São Tomé and Príncipe's justice and security leaders on cybercrime and online protection
